name: Cold-start lithium-ion battery procedure
value: Multiple starting attempts may be needed. Press the start bu
quote: At low temperatures, however, the starting power of lithium-ion batteries drops to below that of lead batteries. Multiple starting attempts may be needed. Press the start button for 5 seconds, and wait 30 seconds between attempts.

name: Cold start button
value: Push the cold start button in all the way.
quote: Condition Ambient temperature: < 10 °C (< 50 °F) - Push the cold start button in all the way.

name: Charging time at low temperatures
quote: The charging time may be longer at low temperatures.

name: salt_wash
quote: If the vehicle has been used on salted roads, use cold water for cleaning after riding.
